title: Quote
description: Inspirational or famous quote with author attribution, category, tags, language, and engagement metrics. Used for quote databases, inspiration platforms, and content management systems.

author.description: Name of the person who said or wrote the quote

category.description: Quote category (e.g., Inspiration, Success, Love, Wisdom, Humor)

tags.description: Array of tags for categorization and search

language.description: Language code of the quote (e.g., en, es, fr)

likes.description: Number of likes or favorites the quote has received

created_at.description: Timestamp when the quote was added to the database
